class.slave.family.BYZ: into a family of household slaves
class.landowner.family.BYZ: into the family of a provincial archon
class.noble.BYZ: a family of the court nobility
class.noble.family.BYZ: into the family of a senator at court
prof.farmer.desc.BYZ: A plot, a pair of oxen, a vineyard and taxes: every hearth pays the hearth tax.
prof.laborer.desc.BYZ: You haul bales at the harbor and mix lime on building sites, paid by the day.
prof.artisan.desc.BYZ: Your guild has its own rules, prices and warden, all set down in the Book of the Eparch.
prof.weaver.desc.BYZ: Linen and wool for your own family and for sale to the neighbors.
prof.midwife.desc.BYZ: You deliver babies and know your herbs. Male physicians rarely attend a birth.
prof.merchant.desc.BYZ: A shop on the Mese or goods at the harbor. The Eparch watches your prices, weights and profits.
prof.sailor.desc.BYZ: Merchant ships sail from Cherson to Alexandria. Dangerous, but it pays.
prof.soldier.desc.BYZ: A soldier of the theme: in return for its military land, the family provides a fighter with horse and arms.
prof.scribe.desc.BYZ: You draw up contracts and wills. Notaries are admitted only after an examination.
prof.physician.desc.BYZ: You treat patients according to Galen and serve in a monastery hospital, a xenon.
prof.priest.desc.BYZ: A parish priest: you celebrate the liturgy, baptize, marry and bury. You may marry, but only before ordination.
prof.landholder.desc.BYZ: Estates, dependent tenants called paroikoi, and endless lawsuits with the neighbors.
prof.magistrate.desc.BYZ: An office at court or in a theme: general, logothete, judge. Power, and a dangerous closeness to the throne.
prof.matron.as.BYZ: the lady of a great house
prof.matron.desc.BYZ: You run an archon's household: servants, stores, dowries and accounts.
prof.household_slave.desc.BYZ: You serve in your master's house. Law and Church both allow for manumission.
prof.field_slave.desc.BYZ: Hard labor on an archon's estate alongside hired hands.
prof.officer.desc.BYZ: You command a hundred soldiers of the theme and answer for every one of them.
prof.workshop_owner.desc.BYZ: Your own workshop, apprentices and a seat in the guild.
prof.shipowner.desc.BYZ: Your own ship, crew and cargo. The Rhodian sea law is on your side, or not.
prof.official.desc.BYZ: Service in one of the government bureaus: seals, scrolls, protocols and a yearly salary, the roga.
prof.monk.desc.BYZ: The tonsure, a cell, the rule of prayer and work in the monastery. The world stays outside the gate.
prof.hegumen.desc: Head of a monastery: the community, its lands and its rule, the typikon.
prof.silk_weaver.desc: Silk is the pride and secret of the empire. Purple cloth is woven for the court alone, and exporting it is forbidden.
prof.akrites.desc: A guard of the eastern frontier: mountain passes, ambushes and raids that end up in songs.
prof.court_eunuch.desc: Many of the highest palace offices, such as praipositos and parakoimomenos, went only to eunuchs. A road to power paid for at a heavy price.
prof.siphonarios.desc: You work the bronze siphon that sprays Greek fire from a dromon's bow. Its recipe is a state secret.
prof.charioteer.desc: Four horses, the stands of the Blues and Greens, and fame across the City. Fewer unbroken bones.
cause.byz_hippodrome: a chariot crash in the Hippodrome
focus.learn.desc.BYZ: A grammar teacher: letters from the Psalter, counting and writing. The family pays
focus.study.desc.BYZ: Grammar, rhetoric, Homer and the Church Fathers. It costs money
focus.rest.desc.BYZ: Feasts, the Hippodrome, taverns and conversation
focus.service.desc.BYZ: Drills with the theme army and campaigns
lifestyle.food.plain.desc.BYZ: Bread, bean soup, olives and cheese
lifestyle.food.varied.desc.BYZ: Fish, fruit and honeyed wine. Good for your health
lifestyle.food.feasts.desc.BYZ: Banquets with garos fish sauce, game and sweets. Expensive
lifestyle.exercise.gymnasium.desc.BYZ: Riding, hunting and polo on horseback. Stronger and healthier
lifestyle.medicine.temple.desc.BYZ: Prayers and nights beside the relics of Saints Kosmas and Damian, holy springs
lifestyle.medicine.physician.desc.BYZ: A physician from the xenon looks after the family. Expensive, but fewer die
lifestyle.baths.daily.desc.BYZ: The city baths: cleanliness, talk and news. You must live in a city
prof.icon_painter.desc.BYZ: Wooden panels, gesso, egg tempera and the strict canon of holy faces.
